row.evidence: Darktrace's Offering Product Specification says SAML SSO and LDAP are configured on the System Config page and users are managed on the Permissions Admin page; SCIM is not mentioned on any public Darktrace page.
row.notes: Quote-only: no pricing page; darktrace.com/demo offers a demo, a 30-day trial and a 'tailored quote'. Researched as the ActiveAI Security Platform (Threat Visualizer admin UI). The public product specification documents SAML SSO and LDAP authentication and in-product user/group management (Permissions Admin), plus a REST API, but says nothing about SCIM or automated user provisioning. Product docs are in the login-gated Customer Portal, so status stays unknown. The only Okta OIN entry is the 'Darktrace Partner Portal' SWA app (2015); no Entra gallery tutorial.

plans.name: Darktrace ActiveAI Security Platform (quote)
plans.notes: No public tiers; modules (/NETWORK, /EMAIL, /CLOUD, /IDENTITY, /OT, /ENDPOINT) are quoted.

scim.notes: No SCIM mention in the public Offering Product Specification v1.7.0 (0 'SCIM' hits in the PDF text) or in the darktrace.com sitemap (3,470 English URLs). Product documentation sits in the Darktrace Customer Portal, which requires a login, so availability is not publicly disclosed.

user_api.notes: The Threat Visualizer REST API is documented only in the login-gated Customer Portal; the public spec does not say whether it covers user or permission management.

okta.notes: OIN 'Darktrace Partner Portal' (last updated Dec. 11 2015) marks only SWA (page markup); it is the partner portal, not the platform.

entra.notes: No Darktrace entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (entra-docs saas-apps toc.yml); darktrace-tutorial 404.
